title: Rosemary Beach Inn 203 | Rosemary Beach Condo | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: This room offers a birds-eye view of Rosemary Beach's unique architecture and dazzling sunsets. Rosemary Beach Inn 203 is the perfect getaway for couples.
description_expanded:
Conveniently located near Town Center and Beach

This room offers a birds-eye view of Rosemary Beach's unique architecture and dazzling sunsets. It also features a pillow-top king bed with 400-count triple sheeting, Cuddledown comforter, and a desk with chair.

All Rosemary Beach Inn rooms feature free Wi-FI service, a flat screen LED television with Blu-Ray DVD player and free DVD rental, mini-fridge and Keurig K-Cup coffee brewer.

**This property requires a 2 night minimum stay.**

**1 set of Complimentary Beach Chairs included on full days of your stay (arrival and departure date can be added for an additional fee).**

** Street parking only.**
